answer.text: Force the PM to use the client's chosen auditor for PM firm's accounts
Appoint a CA to audit books and accounts relating to HIS/HER OWN transactions with the PM

explanation.text: The Logic: Client can appoint a CA for audit of transactions involving their account; PM must co-operate. The Trap: Forcing PM's firm audit is not the right. Cross-Exam Context: Same right in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Offer a standard list of co-operating CAs to reduce audit friction.
